g.text: ROBINHOOD CHAIN AUTO-TRADING BOT — FINAL FLOW
Wallet connection alone does not authorize autonomous trading; START is an explicit enable action.
policy-bound signer — no Telegram private key
Daily loss limit: $15 | Open positions: 3/5 | Last scan: 17s
win rate • profit factor • drawdown • signal accuracy
store every trade for strategy evaluation
Feedback Loop: trade outcome → PnL → signal label → strategy metrics → offline tuning
Recommended rollout: paper trading → small live capital → increase limits after execution, risk, and PnL are validated.
MAX POSITION SIZE: 5% of bot capital
MAX DAILY LOSS: 10% of bot capital
Every open position continuously checks TP / SL + insider risk + liquidity health.
Hard exit conditions override strategy score.
Liquidity drain • suspicious insider exit • honeypot/security change • abnormal slippage
FINAL STRATEGY: AUTO DISCOVER → AUTO ANALYZE → AUTO BUY → MONITOR → SELL AT +20% OR -5% → UPDATE PnL → CONTINUE / PAUSE
Build from zero • Clean Architecture • Lazy Dev by Ponytail • Autonomous discovery • Capital recovery + runner
CONNECT WALLET → CONFIGURE POLICY → START AUTO TRADING → DISCOVER → ANALYZE → SCORE → RISK GUARD → BUY
→ MONITOR → (-5% EXIT | +100% CAPITAL RECOVERY → RUNNER) → PnL → TELEGRAM → FEEDBACK → REPEAT
Clean Architecture • deterministic risk logic • modular monolith first • interfaces at external
automate boring work • no premature infrastructure • observable + recoverable
SL = -5% • Capital Recovery = +100% • runner after recovery • insider = risk signal, not fixed
hard rejects override strategy • scale only after measured edge
Implementation blueprint: start lean on one VPS, PostgreSQL, Redis, NATS, Telegram, RPC, and a dedicated bot wallet.
